name: allRecordsSelected
label: All Records Selected
description: Indicates whether all the records in a table have been selected

name: selectedRecords
label: Selected records
description: If `allRecordsSelected` is false, contains all the records that have been selected on a page

name: exceptedRecords
label: Excepted Records
description: If `allRecordsSelected` is true, contains the records that have been deselected

name: selectedRecordsFullPath
label: Selected records full path
description: If `allRecordsSelected` is false, contains all the records that have been selected on a page with full hierarical key path

name: exceptedRecordsFullPath
label: Excepted Records full Path
description: If `allRecordsSelected` is true, contains the records that have been deselected with full hierarical key path

name: query
label: Query
description: Encoded query string that filters results of the current table

name: table
label: Table
description: The name of the current table
